lore: {name}: Two blocks long, so it reaches further than any piston. Quartz, a block of redstone and iron make the barrel.
use: A signal of 1 to 7 pushes the head one block out, 8 to 15 two blocks. It pushes like a Vanilla piston (12 blocks at most) and moves in single steps.
secret: Weaken a strong signal with Signal Dampeners: 15 minus three stages of 3 is 6, which is only one block. The piston itself cannot be pushed.

lore: {name}: A repeater that gives a little of the signal away.
use: Right-click to set the stage 0 to 3 (the lamps count it). The output is the input minus the stage, one redstone tick later.
secret: Stage 0 passes the signal on unchanged and only delays it. Signals from the sides are ignored.
